genius.notes: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank holds a Nebraska Digital Asset Depository Institution charter finally approved November 12, 2025, following earlier conditional approval. The June 15 bank terms and customer agreement describe transferable fixed-dollar eUSD stablecoins, reserve backing and eligible-account redemption; a separate connected-bank deposit does not make the circulating token an excluded deposit. Current issuer pages promise regular reserve disclosures and monthly external-auditor attestations; no report was located on the reviewed eUSD/Digital Cash pages. The June 23, 2026 issuer announcement supports plans for GENIUS Act-compliant yield on eUSD, subject to regulatory requirements, but does not announce a PPSI application, registration or identifiable GENIUS issuance route. Conservatively retain no-public-authorization-found rather than upgrading a yield-product statement to issuer-announced-intent. No token-specific GENIUS approval/application or state qualification was found in the dated scoped review. Nebraska DADI charter alone is not GENIUS approval. Expected Act effective date remains January 18, 2027.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public PPSI approval, state-qualified approval or official GENIUS pending application naming Telcoin, Inc. d/b/a Telcoin Digital Asset Bank/eUSD was found in the opened issuer, OCC, Nebraska and Treasury materials or exact-name regulator searches. The Nebraska charter is separately confirmed. June 23 issuer plans for GENIUS-compliant yield do not identify an issuance authorization pathway or filing. No U.S. action naming the issuer was located in the scoped searches or OFAC 2026 chart. This review does not rule out confidential filings, establish a system-wide absence of approvals, or adjudicate Nebraska state-regime comparability.
